violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. - Observed 3 (three) dry hand sinks at the beginning of the inspection.

Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooked potentially hazardous food - cooked hamurgers - was not cooled properly from 70F to 41F or below within four hours. - Hamburger temped between 45F - 48F; observed during inspection. Discarded.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Clean exteriors of equipment on the line and prep area.
